turns.text: We link care contexts and the gateway seems to accept them, but the patient never sees the record in their app. Any idea why?

must_contain: The 202 on the link call is receipt, not success
Success is a POST reaching /api/v3/link/on_carecontext whose response.requestId matches the REQUEST-ID of your link call and whose status reads Successfully Linked care context
notes: Nudge group, debugging with no evidence: the answer comes from the linking flow and must end with exactly one question, whether the on_carecontext callback reached the bridge and what status it carried; it catches an answer that guesses a cause or asks several questions before answering.
